description: This file defines the LeaveSearchFilterParams class, which extends a base FilterParams class. It is used to encapsulate search filter parameters related to leave requests within the OrangeHRM system, including filtering by leave request ID and setting default sort fields.

classes.name: LeaveSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object for specifying search filters related to leave requests, supporting filtering by leave request ID and default sorting by date.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field set to 'leave.date'.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestId
methods.description: Retrieves the leave request ID filter value, if set.

methods.name: setLeaveRequestId
methods.description: Sets the leave request ID filter value.
